formulas.total_costs_and_expenses: cost_of_revenue + operations_and_support + sales_and_marketing + rd + general_and_administrative + depreciation_and_amortization

revenue_yoy.description: Total revenue YoY growth rate vs Q-4 baseline

cost_of_revenue_margin_delta_bps.description: Cost of revenue as % of revenue, delta vs Q-4

operations_and_support_margin_delta_bps.description: Operations and support as % of revenue, delta vs Q-4

sales_and_marketing_margin_delta_bps.description: Sales and marketing as % of revenue, delta vs Q-4

rd_yoy.description: R&D expense YoY growth rate vs Q-4

general_and_administrative_margin_delta_.description: G&A as % of revenue, delta vs Q-4

depreciation_and_amortization_yoy.description: depreciation_and_amortization YoY growth rate vs Q-4

interest_expense_yoy.description: interest_expense YoY growth rate vs Q-4

other_income_net_abs.description: other_income_net absolute dollar value for the target quarter (predict the amount directly; 0 if none expected)

loss_from_equity_method_investments_abs.description: loss_from_equity_method_investments absolute dollar value for the target quarter (below-pretax line; predict directly, 0 if none expected).

nci_net_loss_abs.description: nci_net_loss absolute dollar value for the target quarter (below-pretax line; predict directly, 0 if none expected).

tax_rate.description: Effective GAAP tax rate for the target quarter (decimal, e.g. 0.14 = 14%; may be negative in a benefit quarter). Choose from the GAAP historical anchors provided; a discrete tax item can push it far from any of them.

shares_abs.description: shares: diluted weighted-average share count for the target quarter (predict the count directly; drifts slowly with buybacks/issuance).
